c74object.name: evi_pade
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_pade.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_pade.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
A collection of trigonomic Padé approximations. Padé approximations are a tried and tested method of approximation often used in computer calculations. Approximations are faster than library functions but less accurate. You should be careful using approximations - they can break your code. In evieve all approximations are tested to work on the code in which they are used.
